metadata.description: Claude Code plugin that wraps the AICowork YuE Studio API (YuE2-3B + YuE2-Vae, /api/v1/jobs) — songs with lyrics, instrumental-LoRA pieces with structure tags, ABC score planning/editing, cover transcription from recordings, exact plan re-rendering, and FLAC/WAV/MP3 output, with agent-decided caption / cot / preset / token-cap / seed.

plugins.name: aicowork-yue
plugins.description: /aicowork-yue:status, :config, :create, :cover, :score, :jobs — text → music via AICowork YuE Studio. The create skill picks vocal vs instrumental LoRA, writes the caption and tagged lyrics or structure plan, chooses cot/preset/token cap/seed, feeds ABC scores or re-renders saved plans, submits with an Idempotency-Key, polls and saves audio + score.
